# Vendored MIDI parser/writer

@tonejs/midi 2.0.28 by Yotam Mann, including midi-file and array-flatten.
Source: https://github.com/Tonejs/Midi

The pinned package-lock.json in toolchain records the fetched packages. The build/Midi.js browser distribution is embedded unchanged except for removal of its source-map reference. MIT licenses are preserved alongside it.
The local `.cjs` suffix also supports CLI import inside workspaces with `type: module`.
